chapters.name: The tooling your agents wish they had
chapters.narration: Boomtick is a template repository that hands your autonomous agents the tooling real projects need. No glue code, no re-invented workflows, no key hunting.

chapters.name: Three pillars
chapters.narration: Boomtick ships three pillars. The MCP server exposes GitHub operations to any agent host. The T D command line is the local fallback tier. And the review framework measures blast radius before code lands.
bullets: A Model Context Protocol server for GitHub operations
The T D command line for local automation
An AI review framework with blast radius analysis

chapters.name: Wire it up in one command
chapters.narration: The MCP server gives agents structured access to pull requests, repository state, and CI logs. One command registers it with Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code. Integration is zero submodule: the server ships as an npm package, a docker image, and a composite action.

chapters.name: Rescue pull requests, safely
chapters.narration: The rescue agent scouts conflicted pull requests, applies minimal repairs in isolated git worktrees, and proves the fix with real verification suites. Every mutating action sits behind explicit write guards, and every shell command runs through a token redacting allowlist. Your working directory is never touched.
bullets: Scouts conflicted pull requests and overlapping branches
Applies minimal repairs in isolated git worktrees
Proves the fix with test and Playwright suites

chapters.name: Reviews that see the blast radius
chapters.narration: The review framework pairs GitHub Models for low latency code review with Gemini for multi-modal visual interface analysis. It is routed through LangChain, with retrieval augmented triage built in.
